pr_title: Fix union-types when aggregating on inline conversion function
pr_body:
Fix union-types when aggregating on inline conversion function
A query like:

```
FROM sample_data, sample_data_str
| STATS count=count(*) BY client_ip = TO_IP(client_ip)
| SORT count DESC, client_ip ASC
| KEEP count, client_ip
```

This fails due to unresolved aggregates from the union-type in the grouping key. The fix was to find the FieldAttribute/InvalidMappedField combination and convert it to UnresolvedAttribute, so it can be found and resolved by the existing fix from https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/110476

Fixes #110627

issue_context.title: Another failing edge case for union-types and stats grouping on inline type conversions
issue_context.body:
In the work at https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/110476 we fixed a bunch of queries involving inline type conversion expressions on the grouping key. However, all those tests used the newer syntax `client_ip::ip`, and it turns out the fix does not appear to cover the older syntax `client_ip = TO_IP(client_ip)`. The following test fails with exception:

```
multiIndexIpStringStatsInline
required_capability: union_types
required_capability: union_types_agg_cast

FROM sample_data, sample_data_str
| STATS count=count(*) BY client_ip = TO_IP(client_ip)
| SORT count DESC, client_ip ASC
| KEEP count, client_ip
;

count:long  |  client_ip:ip
8           |  172.21.3.15
2           |  172.21.0.5
2           |  172.21.2.113
2           |  172.21.2.162
;
```

The exception is:

```
Invalid call to dataType on an unresolved object ?client_ip
stack_trace: org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.core.capabilities.UnresolvedException: Invalid call to dataType on an unresolved object ?client_ip
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.core.expression.UnresolvedAttribute.dataType(UnresolvedAttribute.java:101)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.core.expression.Attribute.canonicalize(Attribute.java:146)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.core.expression.Expression.canonical(Expression.java:162)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.core.expression.Expressions.canonicalize(Expressions.java:96)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.core.expression.Expression.canonicalize(Expression.java:171)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.core.expression.Expression.canonical(Expression.java:162)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.core.expression.ExpressionSet.add(ExpressionSet.java:81)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.optimizer.rules.PruneRedundantSortClauses.rule(PruneRedundantSortClauses.java:24)
	at org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.optimizer.rules.PruneRedundantSortClauses.rule(PruneRedundantSortClauses.java:17)
```

review_comments: The test on line 284 of union_types.csv-spec was already requiring this capability (and therefor ignored). We now enabled this capability and fix the failing test that resulted.
